crossRefs.note: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that…
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
“I, Yahweh, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of…
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…

crossRefs.note: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

crossRefs.note: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

translations.web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
translations.bsb: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
translations.kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
translations.asv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting. Psalm 140 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
